lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He leans against the velvet door
His polished shoes across the floor
A silver glass held in his hand
The finest man in all the land
[Pre-Chorus]
With a wink and a knowing smile
He makes the evening linger for a while
[Chorus]
Under the lights of the grand design
Two hearts in rhythm, perfectly in line
Dancing through shadows of gold and gray
Chasing the magic of a perfect day
[Verse]
She moves with grace like a drifting leaf
A melody soft, a sweet relief
Her silk dress swishes like a sigh
A spark of fire in a midnight sky
[Pre-Chorus]
With a glance and a steady gaze
She captures his heart in a velvet haze
[Chorus]
Under the lights of the grand design
Two hearts in rhythm, perfectly in line
Dancing through shadows of gold and gray
Chasing the magic of a perfect day
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Just a moment whispered, just a breath caught deep
A secret promise that they both will keep
[Chorus]
Under the lights of the grand design
Two hearts in rhythm, perfectly in line
Dancing through shadows of gold and gray
Chasing the magic of a perfect day
[Outro]
